answer: In Proof of Agent, sybil resistance couples identity bonding with correlated-fault detection: if k coordinated identities equivocate on the same decision, aggregate penalties scale quadratically as O(k²), rather than linearly. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the bonded capital burned, making large swarms economically untenable. Thus a haven or island of colluding nodes cannot hide behind fragmentation; each added identity increases exposure like a comet accelerating toward impact.
